risk_description: Chat form asks for phone number and address although neither is needed to answer queries.
mitigation: Apply data minimization; remove optional fields; document purpose of each field.

risk_title: Unclear data usage and consent practices
risk_description: Privacy notice does not mention that chats are processed by a language model.
mitigation: Show a clear AI-processing notice and consent prompt before the chat starts.

risk_description: No age check; users under 18 could submit personal details.
mitigation: Add an age gate; avoid collecting sensitive information unless necessary.

risk_description: Names and emails remain in the text after cleaning and tokenisation.
mitigation: Redact personal identifiers during preprocessing; re-test for re-identification.

risk_description: Intermediate files are saved in a shared folder without access control.
mitigation: Apply role-based access control and encrypt intermediate files.

risk_description: Free-text samples kept for tuning may include addresses typed by customers.
mitigation: Use automated PII detection and remove records that fail the check.

risk_title: Exposure of sensitive information in prompts
risk_description: Customers paste card numbers and ID numbers into the chat prompt.
mitigation: Redact personal identifiers before sending prompts; show an input warning.

risk_title: Potential prompt logging and information exposure
risk_description: All prompts are logged in plain text and readable by support staff.
mitigation: Restrict access to prompt logs and mask sensitive values before logging.

risk_title: Sensitive health data volunteered in queries
risk_description: Customers sometimes mention medical conditions when asking about returns.
mitigation: Detect and block sensitive categories; train staff on handling such logs.

risk_description: Prompts are processed by an external model host with unclear data handling.
mitigation: Review third-party data-processing arrangements; sign a data-processing agreement.

risk_title: Excess context passed to the model
risk_description: The full chat history, including old personal details, is sent with each request.
mitigation: Limit context to the last few turns and strip identifiers.

risk_title: Prompt injection exposing other users' data
risk_description: Crafted prompts might trick the bot into revealing earlier conversation content.
mitigation: Isolate sessions and test outputs for accidental disclosure.

risk_title: Personal data leakage through generated outputs
risk_description: The bot repeats full addresses and order numbers in replies.
mitigation: Test generated outputs for accidental disclosure; mask personal data in replies.

risk_description: The bot may answer with another customer's details after a session mix-up.
mitigation: Bind sessions to authenticated users and add automated disclosure tests.

risk_description: Replies containing personal data are cached and reused for similar questions.
mitigation: Do not cache replies containing personal data.

risk_description: Transcripts are kept for 730 days with no business reason.
mitigation: Define and enforce retention periods (e.g. 90 days) with automatic expiry.

risk_description: The transcript database is readable by all engineers.
mitigation: Restrict access with RBAC, encryption at rest and audit logs.

risk_description: Database backups are stored without encryption.
mitigation: Encrypt backups and apply the same retention limits.

risk_description: Transcripts are shared with an analytics vendor without a signed agreement.
mitigation: Review third-party arrangements; share de-identified data only.

risk_description: The vendor may process data in other countries; locations are not documented.
mitigation: Document processing locations and add transfer clauses to the contract.

risk_title: Lack of a data deletion procedure
risk_description: Deletion is manual and ad hoc; backups and logs are never cleaned.
mitigation: Establish secure deletion procedures covering databases, logs and backups.

risk_description: Deletion requests are not forwarded to the analytics vendor.
mitigation: Add vendor deletion to the procedure and confirm in writing.

risk_description: No documented steps exist if a privacy incident or leak occurs.
mitigation: Establish incident response and privacy review procedures.

risk_description: Access logs keep IP addresses for 30 days.
mitigation: Keep as is but document the purpose and retention period.
